Consider adoption of Resolution 2016-49 requesting necessary funding for required noticing pursuant to EMC Chapter 30.00 (Proposition A) and continued legal services related to the Housing Element Update (WC14B). Contact Person: Senior Planner Strong and Management Analyst Noel
Staff recommends that the Council: 1. Adopt Resolution No. 2016-49 approving an off-cycle budget appropriation to the Housing Element Update (WC14B) project budget of $40,704 for required noticing; 2. Authorize the City Manager enter into a new contract with Post Haste Direct for printing, data processing, and mailing services for the City Council public hearing notice in an amount not to exceed $51,914 and authorize the City Manager flexibility to pursue the most cost effective, legally-compliant and informative public notice format possible; and 3. Authorize the City Manager to amend the contract with Hogan Law Firm APC for an additional amount of $10,000 for continued legal services for a total amount not to exceed $20,000, remaining within the existing project budget (no new funding is requested).

Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commissionâ€™s denial of a Tentative Map Density Bonus, Major Use Permit and Coastal Development Permit for a Planned Residential Development including the subdivision of an existing 1.25-gross acre lot for eight single family detached houses, one private access road lot and an open space lot. The applicant also elected to utilize the provisions allowed by State Density Bonus Law (SDBL) and is requesting waivers. CASE NUMBER: 14-111 TMDB/MUP/DR/CDP/EIA; APPLICANT: Red Tail Acquisition, LLC; APPELLANT: Red Tail Acquisitions, LLC; LOCATION: 1412 Mackinnon Ave (APN: 260-182-17). Contact Person: Senior Planner Sapaâ€™u
Approve the appeal, set aside the decision of the Planning Commission, and adopt the attached Resolution No. 2016-47 (Attachment CC-1), to approve the project as previously recommended by staff to the Planning Commission on March 17, 2016, with proposed modifications to the architecture of Residences 1 and 8. This option would approve the proposed project.

Public Hearing to consider the introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2015-08 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to Title 2 (Administration) and Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 30.33 (Urban Agriculture) and other amendments; and amendments to the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to make reference to Chapter 30.33 of the Encinitas Municipal Code." Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
Staff recommends the City Council: A) Receive the report; B) Open the public hearing and receive and consider testimony; C) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2015-08, titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to Title 2 (Administration) and Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to add Chapter 30.33 (Urban Agriculture) and other amendments; and amendments to the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans to make reference to Chapter 30.33 of the Encinitas Municipal Code" attached herein as Attachment A with modifications as recommended by staff based on input from Planning Commission; D) Adopt Resolution No. 2016-39 amending the Planning and Zoning development process fees to adopt a new fee of $250 for a new administrative permit (Agriculture Permit) attached herein as Attachment B; and E) Provide staff with direction regarding proposed amendments to Chapter 23.24 (Grading, Erosion and Sediment Control).

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
